name: freeipa-server-gpo-frontend
description: Sources of the GPUI editor. The build writes one UMD/AMD bundle, ../plugin/ui/grouppolicy/js/app.js, which is committed and installed by the RPM.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-test-root.mjs && vitest run --project unit --project integration
scripts.test:ipa: bash scripts/ipa-up.sh && REQUIRE_IPA=1 vitest run --project e2e && bash scripts/ipa-native.sh
scripts.format: prettier --write src dev scripts tests '*.mjs' tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src dev scripts tests '*.mjs' tsconfig.json package.json .prettierrc.json
